   398	def _handle_plan(obj):
   399	    if set(obj) != {"mode", "capacities", "flows", "warmup", "pinned",
   400	                    "offers"}:
   401	        raise Bad("plan keys")
   402	    caps = _parse_caps(obj["capacities"])
   403	    flows, _ = _parse_flows(obj["flows"], caps, False, 22)
   404	    warmup = _int_in(obj["warmup"], 0, 1000000000)
   405	
   406	    pinned = obj["pinned"]
   407	    if pinned.__class__ is not list:
   408	        raise Bad("pinned not list")
   409	    pinned_set = set()
   410	    for pid in pinned:
   411	        if pid.__class__ is not str or pid not in {fl.id for fl in flows}:
   412	            raise Bad("pinned flow")
   413	        if pid in pinned_set:
   414	            raise Bad("pinned duplicate")
   415	        pinned_set.add(pid)
   416	
   417	    offers = obj["offers"]
   418	    if offers.__class__ is not dict:
   419	        raise Bad("offers not object")
   420	    if set(offers) != {fl.id for fl in flows}:
   421	        raise Bad("offers keys")
   422	
   423	    runs_by_index = []
   424	    total_header_bytes = 0
   425	    for fl in flows:
   426	        raw = offers[fl.id]
   427	        if raw.__class__ is not list or len(raw) > 256:
   428	            raise Bad("offers runs")
   429	        runs = []
   430	        flow_total = 0
   431	        for run in raw:

   433	                raise Bad("run keys")

   435	            if len(header) != fl.H:
   436	                raise Bad("run header size")

   438	            total_header_bytes += len(header)
   439	            flow_total += count
   440	            runs.append((header, count))
   441	        if flow_total > 1000000000:
   442	            raise Bad("run count total")
   443	        runs_by_index.append(runs)

   445	        raise Bad("run header bytes budget")
   446	
   447	    return _plan_solve(flows, caps, warmup, pinned_set, runs_by_index)
